message.content: 20 美元大約等於 15–16 英鎊（約 15.6 英鎊，按 1 USD ≈ 0.78 GBP 的近期匯率計算）。實際金額會因匯率波動而略有不同，若需要精確數字，建議查詢當天的即時匯率。

We need to provide an approximate conversion based on current exchange rates. We don't have real-time data. We can approximate or say we need to check current rates. We could use a function to get weather but not relevant. There's no function for currency conversion. So we should answer with approximate conversion and note that rates fluctuate.
